task_message:
Case M13: segment the myxoid soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 480x480x294 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
The case is finished. 

**Summary:** I segmented the myxoid soft-tissue tumor in case M13 (T2-weighted, 1 mm isotropic). The lesion is a large, multiloculated T2-hyperintense mass in the soft tissues of the right lateral hip/peritrochanteric region, clearly asymmetric compared with the normal contralateral side.

Workflow:
1. Localized the lesion on coronal/sagittal/axial contact sheets, then confirmed it on a marked axial slice.
2. Seeded the model with a positive point on the dominant locule (v1) and progressively incorporated adjacent, equally hyperintense locules using the intensity-based candidate proposals (v2–v3), plus a model point prompt to capture smaller satellite lobules at the superior end (v4).
3. Removed six tiny stray components with `keep_component` (v5).
4. Verified the full extent on a 5-slice-per-plane final review — no lesion tissue beyond the superior/inferior, anterior/posterior, or medial/lateral ends; rejected the large diffuse candidates that simply enclosed surrounding fat.

Final mask: single connected component, **183.1 mL**, spanning axial 137–241, coronal 179–238, sagittal 296–412, with the outline following the lobulated tumor boundary in all three planes. Confidence: medium (boundary is well-defined, though the multilocular periphery and thin extensions leave slight uncertainty).
